name: Acaraje black-eyed pea fritters with shrimp filling
ingredients: black eyed peas; garlic; green chilli; red onions; plain flour; salt; chilli powder; baking powder; vegetable oil; ginger; raw tiger prawns; plum tomatoes; coriander; lime
instructions: Make the shrimp filling, blend the pea fritter mixture, fry spoonfuls until crisp, then fill and serve with lime.

name: Adana kebab
ingredients: romano pepper; lamb mince; red pepper paste; pul biber; sunflower oil
instructions: Finely chop the pepper, mix with lamb mince and spices, shape onto skewers, then grill until browned and cooked through.

name: Air Fryer Egg Rolls
ingredients: olive oil; ground pork; garlic; ginger; carrots; scallions; cabbage; soy sauce; rice vinegar; egg roll wrappers; duck sauce
instructions: Cook the pork and vegetables, season with soy and vinegar, wrap in egg roll wrappers, then air fry until crisp.

name: Air fryer patatas bravas
ingredients: potatoes; olive oil; onion; garlic; paprika; tomato puree; tinned tomatoes; basil leaves
instructions: Soak and dry the potatoes, air fry until crisp, then serve with a paprika tomato sauce and basil.

name: Ajo blanco
ingredients: white bread; almonds; extra virgin olive oil; garlic clove; red wine vinegar; salt
instructions: Soak the bread, blend with almonds, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, salt, and water, then chill before serving.

name: Alfajores
ingredients: all purpose flour; cornstarch; butter; sugar; egg yolks; lemon zest; dulce de leche; desiccated coconut
instructions: Cream butter and sugar, add yolks and lemon zest, mix the dough, bake cookies, then sandwich with dulce de leche.

name: Algerian Bouzgene Berber Bread with Roasted Pepper Sauce
ingredients: red pepper; tomato; olive oil; garlic; jalapeno; salt; semolina; water
instructions: Roast peppers and tomatoes, blend them into sauce, prepare semolina dough, cook the bread, and serve together.

name: Algerian Carrots
ingredients: water; carrots; olive oil; salt; black pepper; ground cinnamon; ground cumin; garlic; thyme; bay leaf; lemon juice
instructions: Steam carrots until tender, then toss with olive oil, garlic, spices, herbs, and lemon juice.

name: Algerian Flafla Bell Pepper Salad
ingredients: green pepper; olive oil; red onions; garlic; salt; pepper; plum tomatoes
instructions: Roast peppers until soft, peel and chop them, then cook with onions, garlic, tomatoes, oil, salt, and pepper.

name: Algerian Kefta Meatballs
ingredients: ground beef; garlic; onion; salt; pepper; plum tomatoes; parsley; water
instructions: Mix beef with garlic and onion, shape into meatballs, simmer with tomatoes and parsley, then serve hot.

name: Amok Trey Cambodian Fish Curry
ingredients: fish fillet; coconut milk; red curry paste; fish sauce; brown sugar; chicken stock; egg; kaffir lime leaves; vegetable oil; cilantro; lime
instructions: Whisk coconut curry sauce, add fish and egg, steam in banana leaves or bowls, then finish with herbs and lime.

name: Antiguan Breakfast Chop Up and Saltfish
ingredients: egg plants; callaloo; pumpkin; garlic; onion; butter; salt; black pepper
instructions: Cook eggplant, greens, pumpkin, garlic, and onion with butter until soft, then season and serve for breakfast.

name: Anzac biscuits
ingredients: porridge oats; desiccated coconut; plain flour; caster sugar; butter; golden syrup; bicarbonate of soda
instructions: Mix oats, coconut, flour, and sugar, stir in melted butter and syrup, shape biscuits, and bake until golden.

name: Apam balik
ingredients: milk; oil; eggs; flour; baking powder; salt; unsalted butter; sugar; peanut butter
instructions: Make a pancake batter, cook it thinly in a pan, spread with butter, sugar, and peanut filling, then fold.

name: Apple and Blackberry Crumble
ingredients: plain flour; caster sugar; butter; braeburn apples; demerara sugar; blackberries; cinnamon; ice cream
instructions: Rub butter into flour and sugar, cook the fruit filling, top with crumble, bake until crisp, and serve with ice cream.

name: Apple cake
ingredients: eggs; sugar; self-raising flour; melted butter; vanilla extract; ground cinnamon; apples; salt; ground sugar
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar, fold in flour, butter, vanilla, cinnamon, and apples, then bake until the cake is set.

name: Apple Frangipan Tart
ingredients: digestive biscuits; butter; bramley apples; caster sugar; free-range eggs; ground almonds; almond extract; flaked almonds
instructions: Make a biscuit base, cook apples, spread almond frangipane over the base, top with apples and almonds, then bake.

name: Apple Potato Mash Hete bliksem
ingredients: apples; potatoes; cinnamon stick; maple syrup; ground cinnamon; bacon; cheese; salt; egg; sesame seed
instructions: Boil potatoes and apples together, mash with seasoning, then finish with bacon, cheese, egg, and sesame seed.

name: Apricot and Turkish delight mess
ingredients: mascarpone; greek yogurt; icing sugar; orange blossom water; meringue nests; apricot; turkish delight; almonds; mint
instructions: Whisk mascarpone, yogurt, sugar, and orange blossom water, then fold through meringue, apricot, nuts, and mint.

name: Arepa
ingredients: salt; corn flour; warm water
instructions: Mix corn flour with salted warm water into dough, shape patties, then cook until crisp outside and soft inside.

name: Arepa Pabellon
ingredients: corn arepa; mozzarella cheese; fried ripe bananas; black beans; pico de gallo sauce; shredded meat; tomato; salt; pepper
instructions: Fill a cooked arepa with shredded meat, black beans, fried plantain, cheese, tomato, and pico de gallo.

name: Arepa pelua
ingredients: beef; onion; red pepper; garlic; cumin; oregano; paprika; beef stock; water; salt; cheese; extra virgin olive oil
instructions: Cook beef with aromatics until tender, shred it, reduce the sauce, then fill arepas with beef and cheese.

name: Arnhemse meisjes
ingredients: puff pastry; vanilla sugar; cinnamon; cardamom; lime
instructions: Roll stacked puff pastry with sugar and spices, cut into small pieces, then bake until crisp and caramelized.

name: Arra te Mbushura me Fik Walnut Stuffed Figs
ingredients: figs; walnuts; water; sugar
instructions: Halve figs, fill with walnuts, simmer with water and sugar until syrupy, then cool before serving.

name: Arroz al horno baked rice
ingredients: extra virgin olive oil; pork belly slices; black pudding; bacon lardon; onion; red pepper; plum tomatoes; garlic clove; paprika; chilli flakes; white beans; chicken stock; thyme; paella rice; lemon juice
instructions: Brown the meats, cook vegetables and spices, add beans, stock, and rice, then bake until the rice is tender.
